title: China was preparing for Taiwan question - has Japan changed the syllabus?
description: China was preparing to be ready to invade and occupy Taiwan by 2027, but Japan's changing military posture under Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi appears to have disturbed the plan. As Japan increasingly sees its security tied to that of Taiwan, China is likely to face two foes in any campaign against the self-ruled island.

title: Taiwan's Defence Dilemma: Balancing Between Giants
description: The debate over Taiwan's supplementary defence budget, proposed by President Lai Ching-te, is gaining international attention as the U.S. pushes for its approval.
